parties.popularity_note: No competitive elections. Proxy: the CCP's share of 9th NPC deputies (2,130 of 2,979 = 0.715). This is a gameplay estimate, not a vote share.

factions.name: Leaders associated with Jiang Zemin's Shanghai administration
factions.note: An informal network of officials who worked with Jiang Zemin in Shanghai or rose under his patronage. Commentators often call it the 'Shanghai clique'. It is an informal grouping, not a formal body. Members follow the infobox of the Wikipedia article. Strength is a gameplay estimate.

factions.name: Leaders with a Communist Youth League background
factions.note: An informal grouping of officials whose careers ran through the Communist Youth League leadership; Hu Jintao and Li Keqiang were both First Secretaries of the League. Chinese name 团派 (tuanpai). Members follow the infobox of the Wikipedia article. Strength is a gameplay estimate.

factions.name: Other senior leaders
factions.note: A catch-all for 2000 Politburo Standing Committee members and later leaders not listed in either grouping above. It is a modelling convenience, not a documented faction. Strength is a gameplay estimate.
